mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''
SELECT r.role_key FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET del_flag = 1, username = CONCAT(username, '#del_', user_id), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} AND u.status = 0 AND u.del_flag = 0
SELECT u.user_id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.status = 0 AND u.del_flag = 0 AND (d.dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, d.ancestors))
